name: Source reading and threat modeling
description: Reading target source and citing concrete file:line locations for guards, authority, and money paths.

name: Static pattern and dataflow scanning
description: Rule-driven scanners over source: pattern matches, taint, detector suites.

name: Property and invariant fuzzing
description: Stateful campaigns that call the target repeatedly and assert declared properties or invariants.

name: Coverage-guided byte fuzzing
description: libFuzzer/AFL-style mutation fuzzing driven by instrumentation coverage, distinct from property fuzzing.

name: Symbolic execution and SMT proving
description: Path exploration with a solver, producing paths, models, or counterexamples rather than samples.

name: Concrete execution harness
description: Hand-written executable tests or PoC harnesses that run the target and assert concrete outcomes.

name: Differential and variant analysis
description: Comparing siblings, twins, versions, or forks to surface divergence; hunting variants of a known shape.

name: Compiled-artifact census
description: Enumeration over compiled output rather than source: opcodes, selectors, ABI recovery, ELF sections.

name: Deployed-state reconstruction
description: Reading the live deployment: storage slots, deployed bytecode, on-chain config, forked real state.

name: Economic and composition modeling
description: Costing the full attacker cycle and reasoning across contract/program boundaries and value flows.

name: Dependency and toolchain provenance
description: Auditing dependencies, lockfiles, build reproducibility, and the provenance of the analyzed artifact.
